# Legacy registration rules (DirectInputDriverRegistrar):
# register: COM class in HKLM 64-bit and 32-bit views; OEM in HKLM(64) and HKCU;
#   create OEM key if missing (marker CreatedOemKey=1 in Software\G29Standalone\DirectInput of that root);
#   refuse if OEMForceFeedback CLSID is foreign AND that CLSID has an InprocServer32 in either view;
#   create Axes\0 (default 'Wheel axis', Attributes, FFAttributes) only if missing (marker CreatedSteeringAxis=1);
#   delete and recreate OEMForceFeedback: CLSID, Attributes, Effects\{guid} (default name, Attributes).
# unregister: per root, CreatedOemKey -> delete OEM key tree; else if CLSID is ours delete OEMForceFeedback
#   and (if CreatedSteeringAxis) Axes\0 then Axes when empty; delete marker key, then Software\G29Standalone when empty;
#   then delete the CLSID key tree in both HKLM views.
# diagnose: HKCU OEM CLSID first, then HKLM; library per view from InprocServer32 default (CodeBase when mscoree.dll);
#   registered = CLSID and 64-bit library; orphaned = CLSID and neither library.
